# Witness pack: the three neighbours

Shirley De Leon (Exh. N) · Donata King (Exh. L) · Francia de los Reyes (Exh. M) 

Civil Case No. 26-360, Zschoche v. Balane, MTC Mercedes · prepared 19 October 2026 for Atty. Barandon · internal draft; nothing filed or sent; counsel decides. 

Tags: [VERIFY] = not yet checked against a document · [ASK HER] = only the witness can say; counsel asks, nobody else · [COUNSEL] = counsel's call.

> 

**If you read one page, read this.**

1. **The notarial stamp on all three affidavits (and on Jonathan's) reads "valid until 12/31/2025." The jurats are dated 23 January 2026.** Either the 2026 commission exists and the old stamp was used, or it does not. Please tell us the 2026 commission number so the file can be corrected. If there was no commission on 23 January, the cure is simple and must be done before the first neighbour testifies: each witness re-swears the same affidavit before a currently commissioned notary (Atty. Andrade's commission runs to 31 December 2026), and it is filed and served at least five days before her hearing. Details in Part 1.

2. **Who testifies on 4 November is not yet settled: Mrs. King or Shirley De Leon.** Jonathan's choice on 15 October was King first, pending your word. Either works. De Leon first is the cleaner day: her affidavit carries no baggage and no document outside the record. Please confirm the order, and the two women will be told the exact date.

3. **Each neighbour proves one thing well, and nothing else.** De Leon: what Gloria Balane did in 2020. King: who has occupied the house since 1990. De los Reyes: the fish-drying use and continuous residence since 1979. Keep each to her one thing. None of them can speak to the 1992 power, the 2005 revocation, the 2016 deed or consultation. Those stay with the documents and with Patricia on rebuttal.

4. **Four lines in the affidavits as filed will draw a motion to strike.** Withdraw them on direct rather than defend them: King Q9 "kasama na ang mga defendants"; De Leon Q16 "ginugulo"; de los Reyes Q2 to Q3 "maimpluwensiya" and Q9 "malamang na sinamantala … koneksyon at impluwensiya." Part 2 to Part 4 give the exact words.

5. **No supplemental affidavit for any neighbour.** The rule allows a late submission once. That one allowance is reserved for Patricia. What the neighbours can add is small and can be drawn out on direct within the questions already sworn, or left out.

6. **Documents to carry for the three of them fit in one folder**: the filed affidavits; each witness's original PhilID; Exhibit B and Exhibit C (the two titles, for location questions); and, for your own hand only, the papers listed in each witness's section. Nothing outside the record is offered through a neighbour unless cross opens it and you decide to use re-direct.
